design.split_rule: train < Y-1, validation = Y-1, test = Y (UTC year)

roster.name: continuity_diff
roster.definition: Blue minus red share of today's players who also played the team's previous game

roster.name: tenure_diff
roster.definition: Blue minus red mean log(1 + earlier games for this team) over today's players

roster.name: player_exp_diff
roster.definition: Blue minus red mean log(1 + earlier professional games, any team) over today's players

roster.name: player_exp_prev_diff
roster.definition: Same as player_exp_diff but for the players of each team's previous game, so it needs no knowledge of today's lineup

design.lineup_note: Roster and player-Elo features use the lineup that played, which is known when the game starts but not days before.
